page_note: Page is dominated by cosmological substrate: a teaching about the king equal to his whole comitatus/kingship in wisdom-skill-judgment, mapped onto the sphere with its seven guides and twelve zodiacs and way-leaders of the world; then a new chapter (48) opens on the Three Wells. Editorial elements: the chapter-number/title block (segs 21-22), the apostolic frame at seg 23 (seam flag fires correctly), and the hortatory close at seg 20. Editorial fatigue score driven mostly by the dialogue formula at seg 23, which legitimately marks a chapter boundary.
